label: Paper Quilling
blurb: Builds the picture by paper quilling: thin strips of coloured paper rolled into coils, pinched loose or kept tight, and glued on their edges side by side onto a backing sheet, each coil in the paper colour nearest the picture under it. You look down onto the edges of the strips, so every turn of the spiral is a fine lit lip with a shadowed well between it and the next turn, the coils press into each other's shapes where they meet, and the backing shows in the gaps with the coils' shadows falling across it.
